## `client.navigation`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.navigation.NavigationManager`.

Contextual information about an item.

### `client.navigation.navigation`

Top navigation (`@navigation`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.navigation.NavigationManager.navigation`.

Calls `GET /@navigation` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/navigation.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.navigation.navigation(depth=2)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@navigation?expand.navigation.depth=2 HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@navigation?expand.navigation.depth=2' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/@navigation",
  "items": [
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone",
      "title": "Home"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news",
      "title": "News"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/about",
      "title": "About"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/media",
      "title": "Media"
    }
  ]
}
```

This shows only `@id`, `items`. This shows only `@id`, `title` of each entry.

### `client.navigation.inherit`

Field values an item inherits from its parents (`@inherit`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.navigation.NavigationManager.inherit`.

Calls `GET /news/@inherit` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/inherit.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python

```python

```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/@inherit?expand.inherit.behaviors=plone.allowdiscussion HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/@inherit?expand.inherit.behaviors=plone.allowdiscussion' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
`````

```json
    },
```
